Name: Scarecrow Highlighter
Author: WretchedPenguin
Description:
Highlights the radius the scarecrows protect when:
[list]
[*]Hovering with the mouse over a scarecrow
[*]Holding a scarecrow in your hand (useful when placing a new scarecrow)

[*]Pressing a button to toggle the highlights (useful for checking boundaries, default: L)
[/list]
All of these are configurable, 1 and 2 can be turned on or off and the button to toggle can be changed.

Downloads.Description:
Updated to be compatible with the latest version of the game.

Other notable changes:
* Support for Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)
* Fix range of Deluxe scarecrow
* Support sprinklers
* Shows the source with an icon
